name: Figure group
dimensions: Height 7.62 cm; Height 13.97 cm; Length 31.43 cm; Length 17.15 cm
summary: In the Han dynasty (206BC-AD220) grave goods included replicas of men and animals performing their daily duties, made from pottery but in reduced size, such as this model of a man riding an ox cart. The grave goods would allow the deceased to continue a similar life style in the underworld.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
